# Fictional architecture-review scenarios

These inputs exercise the existing portable contract. They are authored
fictional assessments, with synthetic source revisions and no actual review,
source capture, model judgment, human authority or ratification. JSON admission
cannot determine whether a concern or recommendation is substantively correct.

| Example | Authored scenario | Required boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Coherent](examples/coherent.json) | Consistent responsibility dimensions and an advisory ratify recommendation | Governance remains absent and not-reviewed; no certification or permission is inferred. |
| [Over-engineered](examples/over-engineered.json) | Three hypothetical coordination layers for one demonstrated consumer | Preserve the consequential concern, uncertainty and credible simpler alternative with costs. |
| [Contradictory](examples/contradictory.json) | Conflicting hypothetical canonical ownership | Keep evidence and alternative references; a revise recommendation does not implement the change. |
| [Incomplete](examples/incomplete.json) | Missing hypothetical runtime/deployment input | Preserve partial execution, no completion timestamp and a defer recommendation. |
| [Insufficient evidence](examples/insufficient-evidence.json) | Absent owner/implementation evidence | Keep blocked execution and unverified/unknown concerns rather than an observed defect or fabricated source. |
| [Stale](examples/stale.json) | Expired, well-shaped but unauthenticated supplied human claim | Show stale freshness and unverified human evidence; human disposition remains null. |

The stale fixture is untrusted serialized claim data. No test constructs
TrustedHumanEvidence, verifies a person, imports a human decision or manufactures
ratification. Ordinary revision differences are tested independently from
material architecture change; neither grants trust. The existing native package
controls additionally cover exact digests, public admission, unsafe references,
missing counterarguments, duplicate fields and attempted self-ratification.

Both the closed JSON Schema and reference-helper semantics validate the six
inputs. Native mutation cases reject incomplete reviews that recommend ratify
and consequential concerns without an alternative. Deterministic skill evals
check package/resource assertions; they do not evaluate model reasoning.

The Hygiene governance helper/schemas/policy selection retain their exact
immutable lock and proposed lifecycle. Hygiene owns applicability, human
evidence and materiality policy; Aether owns explanation and assessment; Reflector
owns its Human Alignment Anchor and synchronization boundary. A real review
still ends at the actual human authority. No consumer path, provider write,
architecture mutation, deployment or policy activation is added here.
